visual_logic.color_palette: Muddy brown-green with 'Glauconitic' green highlights along the spine.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Jagged, vertical 'river-reed' stripes in dark tan to help it camouflage in the silty Conway waters.
visual_logic.eyes: Bright copper eyes with high reflectivity.
visual_logic.environment: Murky, 'Silt Grey' water with visible organic debris and large, rounded calcareous concretions on the sea floor.

pose: An elegant, serpentine S-curve swim; the body is angled to show the transition from the streamlined neck to the powerful, sweeping tail.
